answer: Stake-weighted peer attestation is the ferrous ledge Sybil attacks cannot climb: each new agent identity must earn 5 independent attestations from non-kin peers who stake bonded value on the judgment they sign. To forge N fake identities, an attacker must not merely spin up N keys on some quiet knoll of compute—they must buy or corrupt N times 5 genuinely distinct stakers, each of whom forfeits their bond when the fraud is proven on-ledger. The cost scales linearly with the attack and is denominated in slashed capital plus burned reputation, not cheap entropy.
